question: Who must sign the Authority to Release Personal Information form?

claims.text: The Authority to Release Personal Information form (IMM 5475) must be signed by the applicant and, as applicable, their spouse or common-law partner if they also wish to release personal information to the same designated individual, and dependent children 18 years of age or older must complete their own form.
claims.quote: The [IMM 5475 form (PDF, 593.57 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/pdf/kits/forms/imm5475e.pdf) must be signed by the applicant and, as applicable, their spouse or common-law partner if they also wish to release personal information to the same designated individual.

basis: The applicant provided an Authority to Release Personal Information form (IMM 5475) in case e5640785a8c957a693d4da097babd255 designating an individual to receive personal information regarding their Express Entry application.
